title: 净销售额
question: 2025年第三季度各渠道的净销售额
sql:
SELECT
  o.channel AS channel,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount - o.refund_amount), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM orders AS o
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30'
GROUP BY
  o.channel
ORDER BY
  net_revenue DESC,
  channel
LIMIT 1000
